linkedin.caption:
Black Friday is here. A lot of store owners are about to find out how fast their site really is, the hard way.

In a Network Solutions survey of 507 online store owners, 61% said their site crashed during a sale or traffic spike in the past year, and half said it loaded too slowly.

The slowdowns usually come from three places:

→ Heavy images. Product photos over 300 KB, sometimes several MB, on every page.
→ Render-blocking scripts. Code in the page head that makes the browser wait before showing anything.
→ Too many third-party apps. Review, chat and upsell widgets that load from someone else's server. If theirs is slow, so is yours.

Fix the quickest of these today, and plan the rest before Cyber Monday and the Christmas rush.
